name: webscraper
description: AI-powered web scraping platform — Next.js + Tailwind + Supabase + FastAPI + Node.js workers

scripts.dev:web: npm --workspace @webscraper/shared run build && npm --workspace @webscraper/web run dev
scripts.dev:worker: npm --workspace @webscraper/shared run build && npm --workspace @webscraper/worker run dev
scripts.build: npm --workspace @webscraper/shared run build && npm --workspace @webscraper/worker run build && npm --workspace @webscraper/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @webscraper/web run lint && npm --workspace @webscraper/worker run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @webscraper/shared run build && npm --workspace @webscraper/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @webscraper/worker run typecheck && npm --workspace @webscraper/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace @webscraper/shared run test && npm --workspace @webscraper/worker run test
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:engine
